statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of representative home, search listing, media detail, and 404 templates. Optional account, upload, external commercial, and full playback journeys were not covered.

page.framework: Server-rendered multi-page site with client-side enhancement
page.notes: Arabic RTL adult media catalog with mandatory age gate.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark-emulation screenshot was pixel-identical to the default capture; computed color-scheme is normal and the UI is a fixed dark palette.
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, stylesheets still expose transitions and infinite animation rules and contain no matching reduction rule.
The prefers-contrast: more screenshot was byte-identical to default and no contrast-preference adaptation was found, although base contrast passed Lighthouse.
Feature probe found no View Transition CSS/API use; navigation between listing and detail is an abrupt document swap.
No scroll-linked effects or scroll event driven animation were observed on the representative listing; ordinary document scrolling does not add main-thread motion.
The tested grid and detail pages use native scrolling and ordinary links; no custom pointer handlers or gesture UI fought platform behavior.
The header remains static through long listing pages; no scroll-state query, progress indicator, shrinking state, or other position feedback was found.
No tooltip, popover, or edge-positioned menu was required in the tested primary browse/search/detail path.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, popover, or edge-positioned menu was required in the tested primary browse/search/detail path.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Listing-to-detail navigation has no directional transition, moved-focus cue, highlight, or other attention handoff.

The full-screen gate is a necessary age/safety checkpoint for this service, is immediately actionable, and does not contain an upsell; it was judged proportionately rather than as promotional interruption.
The full-screen modal gate is implemented without dialog, popover, details, or equivalent semantic primitive; feature probe counted zero of each.
Desktop and mobile screenshots show dense permanent header controls, menu chrome, GOLD promotion, category labels, and competing cards around the primary content.
At 360x800, home and search both reported scrollWidth 360, horizontal overflow 0, and a valid viewport meta; screenshots show single-column reflow.
Cards resize only through viewport layout; CSS probe found no @container/container-query support for reused cards.
Focus styling is visible, but the objective target probe found 63 of the first 100 visible interactive elements under 44px in one dimension.
The Arabic title, search affordance, listing heading, and content cards make browsing/searching the service purpose clear.
A category/search URL returned a populated listing with 560 links, and a selected result loaded a 200 detail page with media and metadata.
A deliberately missing URL correctly returns HTTP 404, but the mobile visual state provides no visible error explanation, retry, back, or recovery route beyond the age gate.
Throttled Lighthouse measured LCP 6.6s (poor), despite a warm local trace LCP of 1.42s; CLS 0.039 and TBT 70ms were good.
Layout evidence recorded CLS 0 on home and 0.00063 on search, with no meaningful visual jump.
Trace recorded one 74.19ms long task and 24.19ms total blocking time; Lighthouse TBT was 70ms, both light for the tested load.
HAR found parser-blocking CSS and an undeferred head script, ten thumbnail responses without useful cache headers, and 1.24MB transferred; Lighthouse estimated 1.25s render-blocking savings.
Lighthouse estimated 386KiB unused JavaScript and 123KiB unused CSS; HAR identified a 393KB first-party bundle and both jquery.js and jquery.min.js.
Lighthouse failed button-name and link-name; probes found an unlabeled search input/close button and 47 empty unnamed links on the listing.
Lighthouse color-contrast audit passed and screenshots show strong white/yellow-on-blue contrast.
Home has no headings, main, or nav landmarks; detail has no h1; Lighthouse reports an ill-formed agent accessibility tree. Visible focus exists but structure is incomplete.
Arabic gate and navigation copy remain readable without clipping at 360px; body colors have sufficient contrast.
Mobile reflow succeeds and the sampled video has 23 subtitle tracks, but Lighthouse failed viewport user scaling and the probe found 63 undersized targets.
Lighthouse console audit recorded no browser console errors or uncaught exceptions.
DOCTYPE and UTF-8 are valid, but image evidence found all 100 sampled images missing explicit width/height and Lighthouse failed unsized-images.
No deprecated API or permission-on-load failure was found, but Lighthouse reported missing source maps for large first-party JavaScript.
Home, listing, and detail each expose descriptive titles and meta descriptions.
robots.txt is valid and pages are indexable, but the listing contains 47 empty unnamed links and Lighthouse flags restrictive viewport scaling.
No canonical was exposed on home; the Arabic-domain sitemap index points only to www.xnxx.com sitemap URLs, weakening localized canonical consistency.
The rich video detail exposes one JSON-LD block and five Open Graph tags matching its visible entity; home is not itself a rich detail entity.
HTTPS and X-Frame-Options are present, but HSTS and nosniff are absent; CSP permits unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval; the session cookie uses SameSite=None.
The page sets a 180-day session token before interaction and sends 13 third-party requests (336KB), including an unrelated third-party origin; no known tracker signature or exposed secret was found.
Permission states remained prompt and Lighthouse confirmed no geolocation/notification request on load; authentication is optional and outside the representative public browse flow.
Headers evidence shows no HSTS, Permissions-Policy, or nosniff; CSP is broad and allows unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval. Clickjacking protection is present.
Discoverability/no-JS comparison found only 5% home content parity and classified home as a JS shell; search retained 93%, but detail retained only 35%.
The age gate and core header fit inside 360px without clipping, direct listing/detail URLs stabilize, and no failed async dependency appeared in the exercised path.
The app-like media site links a manifest, but it has no start_url and there is no active service worker or offline fallback.
A real 404 status is returned, but the visual 404 state has no visible recovery message/action in the tested mobile view.
The localized document declares lang=ar and dir=rtl, exposes seven hreflang links, and mobile/desktop screenshots render the RTL reading order correctly.
The representative public browse/detail paths expose no dates, currency, durations requiring locale transformation, or user-entered locale-sensitive data.
checkOutcomes.reason: The representative public browse/detail paths expose no dates, currency, durations requiring locale transformation, or user-entered locale-sensitive data.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The tested site surfaces no scheduled event or time-zone-sensitive workflow.
checkOutcomes.reason: The tested site surfaces no scheduled event or time-zone-sensitive workflow.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The mandatory age gate states its purpose, links terms and parental controls, presents equally visible choices, and the tested public flow showed no forced continuity or hidden pricing.
The representative search form has no required fields and no user-entered validation flow; no applicable invalid-submission state exists.
checkOutcomes.reason: The representative search form has no required fields and no user-entered validation flow; no applicable invalid-submission state exists.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No address, payment, sign-in, sign-up, or other autofill-sensitive form was part of the representative public browse path.
checkOutcomes.reason: No address, payment, sign-in, sign-up, or other autofill-sensitive form was part of the representative public browse path.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Commercial GOLD destinations and account management are separate/optional surfaces and were explicitly excluded from this public browse audit.
checkOutcomes.reason: Commercial GOLD destinations and account management are separate/optional surfaces and were explicitly excluded from this public browse audit.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Images evidence found 100/100 legacy JPG/PNG without srcset, 12 oversized images, and 100 missing dimensions; Lighthouse estimated image delivery savings.
Eighty-nine below-fold images lack lazy loading, while Lighthouse measured 5.66MiB total payload and estimated 5.05MiB cache savings.
HAR attributed 336KB across 13 third-party requests; video does not autoplay, but broad nonessential asset loading and weak cache lifetimes are disproportionate before user choice.
This public media catalog exposes no declared agent-facing task surface; the emerging WebMCP opportunity was judged out of scope rather than a defect.
checkOutcomes.reason: This public media catalog exposes no declared agent-facing task surface; the emerging WebMCP opportunity was judged out of scope rather than a defect.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No user task in the representative browse/search/detail journey requires on-device inference; absence is not a defect for this site.
checkOutcomes.reason: No user task in the representative browse/search/detail journey requires on-device inference; absence is not a defect for this site.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten full-list scroll cycles, heap self size increased only 24,801 bytes (0.13%) while node count fell by 162, providing no retained-growth signal.
Search listing heap was approximately 19.0MB with 267,964 nodes, proportionate to a media grid containing hundreds of links and thumbnails.
Before/after heap summaries contain no top Detached* constructor and node/closure counts declined after ten scroll cycles.

principleOutcomes.reason: Every check was judged not applicable to the representative public browse/search/detail scope.

paths.description: Entry/catalog template, age gate, global navigation and preference/security baseline.
Representative category/search listing with hundreds of content links; also used for repeated-scroll memory testing.
Representative media detail page selected from the listing, covering player, captions and entity metadata.
Primary browse journey: entry to populated listing to selected media detail; direct URLs were used to avoid persisting age choice between isolated browser evidence sessions.
Intentional unknown route to assess HTTP and visible recovery behavior.

findings.summary: Theme is fixed dark rather than preference-aware
findings.evidence: Dark capture is identical to default and computed color-scheme is normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme/light-dark() while preserving the existing dark palette.

findings.summary: Motion preferences are not implemented
findings.evidence: Reduced-motion probe found transitions/infinite animation rules but no reduction media rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce layer that removes nonessential transitions and infinite animation.

findings.summary: High-contrast preference does not alter the UI
findings.evidence: Default and prefers-contrast screenshots are byte-identical.
findings.suggestedFix: Add prefers-contrast/forced-colors rules for essential controls and scrolling affordances.

findings.summary: Navigation changes context abruptly
findings.evidence: No View Transition support or attention handoff was found between listing and detail.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document View Transitions with a reduced-motion fallback and preserve focus context.

findings.summary: Long listings provide no scroll-state navigation feedback
findings.evidence: The persistent header has no shrinking/progress/scrolled state.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state queries or a lightweight progress/shrinking state for long result pages.

findings.summary: Age gate lacks modal semantics
findings.evidence: The blocking gate is visually modal but the DOM contains zero dialog/popover elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the age gate with dialog semantics, focus containment, an accessible name, and deterministic focus return.

findings.summary: Permanent chrome competes with content
findings.evidence: Header controls, promotion, menus, and dense category labels crowd both viewports.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively disclose secondary controls and simplify card/header chrome around the primary browse task.

findings.summary: Reusable cards are not container-responsive
findings.evidence: Feature probe found no container-query rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reused card grids containment and adapt card internals with size container queries.

findings.summary: Many interactive targets are too small
findings.evidence: 63 of the first 100 visible controls were under 44px in one dimension; Lighthouse also failed viewport scaling.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target hit areas to at least 44x44 CSS px and retain the existing visible focus treatment.

findings.summary: 404 state provides no visible recovery
findings.evidence: The server correctly returns 404 but the mobile state shows no error explanation or recovery link.
findings.suggestedFix: Render an accessible 404 message with home, search, and back actions independently of the gate.

findings.summary: Throttled LCP is poor
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 6.6s, although local trace LCP was 1.42s and blocking was low.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP element and remove render-blocking/resource discovery delays; verify under throttling.

findings.summary: Critical delivery includes blocking and weakly cached resources
findings.evidence: HAR confirms parser-blocking CSS and an undeferred head script; ten thumbnails lack cache headers.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer noncritical scripts, split critical CSS, and set durable immutable caching for versioned assets/thumbnails.

findings.summary: Large unused and duplicate frontend code ships on load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 386KiB unused JS and 123KiB unused CSS; two jQuery resources are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate jQuery, code-split page-specific behavior, and purge unused CSS.

findings.summary: Controls and links lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name/link-name; probes found unlabeled search controls and 47 unnamed listing links.
findings.suggestedFix: Name icon controls, associate a visible/hidden label with search, and give linked thumbnails descriptive accessible names.

findings.summary: Heading and landmark structure is incomplete
findings.evidence: Home has no headings/main/nav and detail has no h1; the accessibility tree audit failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce one main landmark, semantic navigation, and a logical h1-h2 structure on each template.

findings.summary: Viewport configuration restricts zoom
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-viewport user scaling even though narrow reflow and subtitle tracks work.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale/user-scalable restrictions and retest at 200-400% zoom.

findings.summary: Images omit intrinsic dimensions
findings.evidence: All 100 sampled images lack explicit width/height, creating avoidable sizing ambiguity.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio for every thumbnail and logo.

findings.summary: Large first-party scripts lack valid source maps
findings.evidence: Lighthouse source-map audit failed while deprecation and permission audits passed.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish matching production source maps with access controls appropriate to the deployment.

findings.summary: Unnamed links and restrictive viewport weaken crawl/mobile quality
findings.evidence: Listing has 47 unnamed links and Lighthouse flags restrictive scaling.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every linked card descriptive text and permit user zoom while preserving real hrefs.

findings.summary: Localized canonical and sitemap signals are inconsistent
findings.evidence: Home exposes no canonical, while the Arabic-domain sitemap points only to www.xnxx.com sitemap files.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish self-consistent canonical/hreflang clusters and localized sitemap URLs for indexable Arabic pages.

findings.summary: Browser security policy is incomplete and permissive
findings.evidence: HSTS, nosniff, and Permissions-Policy are absent; CSP allows unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, nosniff, and a restrictive Permissions-Policy; migrate inline/eval code to nonce/hash based CSP.

findings.summary: Pre-interaction persistence and third-party traffic are not minimized
findings.evidence: A 180-day session token is set and 13 third-party requests transfer 336KB before user choice.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay nonessential third parties, shorten/justify persistence, and use the narrowest SameSite posture compatible with the flow.

findings.summary: Home and detail lose core content without JavaScript
findings.evidence: No-JS parity is 5% on home and 35% on detail; home is classified as a JS shell.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core catalog/detail text and links, then enhance interaction client-side.

findings.summary: App manifest is incomplete and no offline fallback exists
findings.evidence: Manifest has no start_url and no service worker controls the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a scoped start_url and a minimal service worker/offline fallback for shell and recovery content.

findings.summary: Image delivery is uniformly legacy and nonresponsive
findings.evidence: 100 sampled images use JPG/PNG without srcset; 12 are oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants and responsive srcset/sizes matched to card display widths.

findings.summary: Below-fold media is eagerly fetched and poorly cached
findings.evidence: 89 below-fold images lack lazy loading; Lighthouse observed 5.66MiB and 5.05MiB potential cache savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold media, cap initial result hydration, and use durable CDN caching.

taskList.title: Restore semantic accessibility: modal dialog, names, landmarks, headings, and zoom
Server-render core home/detail content and useful 404 recovery
Optimize and lazy-load responsive images with durable caching
Reduce LCP, render blocking, unused code, and duplicate jQuery
Harden response headers, CSP, cookie posture, and third-party loading
Make theme, motion, and contrast honor user preferences
Align canonical, localized sitemap, link text, and viewport signals
Simplify chrome and add contextual navigation feedback/transitions
